title: Infographic by @jeetnirnejak: Life in Weeks: a calendar of your life, one square per week. childhood
notes:
Life in Weeks: a calendar of your life, one square per week. childhood, school, career, retirement. when a year fills, the cells don't flip together. each row waits 1.5ms longer than the one above it, so the fill runs down like a short waterfall.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
